where_current_pipeline_incorrectly_requi.finding: Promoted candidates were still framed as manual-quote search paths with `final_status=READY_FOR_MANUAL_OPERATOR_QUOTE_REVIEW`, so useful event analysis was not presented as the primary product.
Missing manual operator odds returns `PRICE_GATE_FAIL`, which is correct for bettable promotion but too strong if reused as an analysis gate.

where_manual_quote_entry_blocks_analysis.finding: The main operator-facing board requires human quote fields for every row, making manual entry look like the next mandatory step instead of an optional downstream step.
Coupon draft semantics assume the operator will populate odds before the portfolio is meaningfully usable.

where_unpriced_candidates_are_downgraded.finding: Eighteen `UNKNOWN_LINE` candidates were downgraded out of the main product even though the blocker was line/price mechanics rather than event-level analytical quality.
Quote-card validation rejects low/unknown evidence cards and assumes quote-card-quality is the promotion target, conflating analytical usefulness with quote readiness.

where_bet_builder_concepts_are_treated_l.finding: Builder groups were emitted as `QUOTE_REVIEW_ONLY` even though they never compute combined odds and are analytically useful before any operator screen is opened.
Draft construction starts from quote cards only, so same-event concepts are implicitly treated as coupon inputs first and analytical concepts second.

where_quote_cards_are_used_as_main_produ.finding: The final report headline metrics center quote cards and manual review rather than priced/partial/unpriced analytical candidates.
Cross-artifact validation is currently quote-card-first, using quote-card counts as the main consistency target.

which_artifacts_must_be_renamed_or_reint.reason: Portfolio semantics must no longer imply coupon assembly before price verification.
Same-event groups are analytical concepts, not proto-coupons.
Quote entry is optional and scoped to the top price-sensitive items only.
The primary board must rank analytical candidates by pricing tier, not by manual quote capture.
